title: Opaque Recipient Addressing
note: `recipient_addressing` is deliberately untyped so a new channel can be supported without changing this block. Verifiers MUST NOT fail on addressing sub-fields they do not recognize: the strict-parsing rule applies to envelope-level fields, not to this payload. Slack carries teamId/channelId/parentTs here, email carries to/cc/bcc, and neither shape is modeled by the protocol.
book_ref: APH Spec: §7.4 Per-channel recipient addressing shapes
